content.intro: This lesson covers Introduction to Excel Functions as part of Excel Function Fundamentals. It follows the attached Excel curriculum, with an emphasis on small examples and verification.
content.why_it_matters: Introduction to Excel Functions turns calculations and repeated reasoning into explicit, reviewable formulas. Small test cases help expose incorrect references, assumptions, and edge cases before a workbook is reused. Compatibility: Check Microsoft’s function reference for the target Excel version, platform, and update channel. Dynamic-array spill behavior and some newer functions are not available in every legacy installation.
